text:
sam: FYI noticing p95 jump on seq=128 gen requests — tracer shows route went Triton -> CUTLASS fallback repeatedly, adding ~12ms per token. Perf-bot alerted at 09:21 UTC.

perf-bot: [ALERT] routing.latency.p95 > 200ms for model: redwood-7b-seq128; sample: 06/11 09:21

anya: Can you paste the routing decision log? also which batcher config was active?

sam: here's the probe log snippet:
```
[09:20:45] route: chosen=triton path; exec_time=18ms
[09:20:45] fallback_detected: reason=cuda-kernel-mismatch -> selected=cutlass; exec_time=31ms
[09:20:46] kv_cache: miss_rate=0.18 memcpy_overhead=7.9ms
```

mike: Interesting — profiling shows CUTLASS path has better single-op throughput but hits memcpy hotspot when KV affinity isn't maintained.
```
kernel | avg_ms | samples
triton_attn | 1.2 | 4200
cutlass_attn | 0.9 | 3800
kv_memcpy | 7.9 | 420
```

mike: note the batcher was using dynamic_batcher with max_batch=64 and prefer_low_latency=true — that increases probe switching for seq distributions with heavy short+long mixes.

anya: Hypothesis: routing probe thresholds are too eager for sequence=128; probe poller sees transient slow tail from CUDA and flips to CUTLASS even though KV cache affinity + memcpy kills overall latency.

sam: quick mitigation: pin seqlen path for seq<=128 to triton in runtime config and bump hysteresis window to 60s. Any objections?

mike: +1. Also suggest adding a small KV affinity score into the arbiter: if kv_cache.hit_rate < 0.9 and memcpy > 3ms, disfavor cutlass for same-host reroutes.

anya: I'll draft a canary patch. plan: 1) runtime flag: routing.preference.kv_affinity=true 2) canary on 5% traffic in us-west-2 3) collect p50/p95 token lat and kv memcpy histogram.

perf-bot: [CANARY CREATED] 1991234567-canary-kv-affinity: 5% traffic -> us-west-2 09:45 UTC

sam: thanks. if this fixes p95 we can make it default. If not, next step is quantized kernel tune and a small batcher tweak (batch_spread=2).

mike: I'll attach a short flamegraph after first 15m of canary.

anya: assigning to me + mike. I'll post followups. :thumbsup:
